# hiok_servicebus_queue (Resource)

A queue with competing consumers, dead-lettering and optional sessions.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Queue name.
- `namespace_id` (String) Owning namespace.

### Optional

- `dead_lettering_enabled` (Boolean) Park poison messages instead of losing them.
- `lock_duration_seconds` (Number) How long a received message stays locked.
- `max_delivery_count` (Number) Attempts before a message is dead-lettered.
- `message_ttl_seconds` (Number) Message lifetime. 0 disables expiry.
- `requires_session` (Boolean) Keep related messages in order on one consumer.

### Read-Only

- `active_message_count` (Number) Messages waiting.
- `dead_letter_count` (Number) Messages dead-lettered.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
